import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 20;
    static final int MAXNODES = 2020;
    static final int INF = 3010;

    static List<Integer>[] graph = new List[MAXNODES];
    static int[] level = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[] match = new int[MAXNODES];
    static int[][] dist_to_boundary = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] cell_capacity = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] enemy_cell = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_s = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static char[][] grid_p = new char[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] dd = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static final int[] dx = {0, 1, -1, 0};
    static final int[] dy = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static List<Integer>[][] source_pool = new List[MAXN][MAXN];
    static List<Integer>[][] dest_pool = new List[MAXN][MAXN];

    static int src_count, dst_count;

    static void link(int a, int b) {
        graph[a].add(b);
        graph[b].add(a);
    }

    static boolean build_level_graph() {
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        Arrays.fill(level, 1, src_count + 1, INF);
        for (int i = 1; i <= src_count; ++i) {
            if (match[i] == 0) {
                level[i] = 0;
                q.offer(i);
            }
        }
        level[0] = INF;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            if (level[u] < level[0]) {
                for (int v_node : graph[u]) {
                    int v = match[v_node];
                    if (level[v] == INF) {
                        level[v] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(v);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return level[0] != INF;
    }

    static boolean dfs_path(int u) {
        if (u == 0) return true;
        for (int v_node : graph[u]) {
            int v = match[v_node];
            if (level[v] == level[u] + 1) {
                if (dfs_path(v)) {
                    match[u] = v_node;
                    match[v_node] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int compute_matching() {
        int result = 0;
        while (build_level_graph()) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= src_count; ++i) {
                if (match[i] == 0 && dfs_path(i)) {
                    ++result;
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                dist_to_boundary[i][j] = t;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid_s[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            grid_p[i] = (" " + line).toCharArray();
        }

        int rx = 0, ry = 0;
        src_count = 1;
        dst_count = 1000;

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXNODES; ++i) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < MAXN; ++j) {
                source_pool[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
                dest_pool[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (grid_s[i][j] == 'Z' || grid_s[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    enemy_cell[i][j] = -1;
                    dist_to_boundary[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (grid_s[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    rx = i;
                    ry = j;
                    dist_to_boundary[i][j] = 0;
                }
                if (Character.isDigit(grid_s[i][j])) {
                    enemy_cell[i][j] = grid_s[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < enemy_cell[i][j]; ++k)
                        source_pool[i][j].add(src_count++);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid_p[i][j])) {
                    cell_capacity[i][j] = grid_p[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < cell_capacity[i][j]; ++k)
                        dest_pool[i][j].add(dst_count++);
                }
            }
        }

        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{rx, ry});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n &&
                    dist_to_boundary[nx][ny] > dist_to_boundary[x][y] + 1 &&
                    enemy_cell[nx][ny] != -1) {
                    dist_to_boundary[nx][ny] = dist_to_boundary[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (enemy_cell[i][j] > 0) {
                    for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                        for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                            dd[x][y] = 100000;
                    Queue<int[]> dq = new LinkedList<>();
                    dd[i][j] = 0;
                    dq.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!dq.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = dq.poll();
                        int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
                        for (int src_id : source_pool[i][j]) {
                            for (int dst_id : dest_pool[x][y]) {
                                link(src_id, dst_id);
                            }
                        }
                        if (dd[x][y] == dist_to_boundary[x][y]) continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n &&
                                enemy_cell[nx][ny] != -1 &&
                                dd[nx][ny] > dd[x][y] + 1 &&
                                dd[x][y] + 1 <= dist_to_boundary[nx][ny]) {
                                dd[nx][ny] = dd[x][y] + 1;
                                dq.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(compute_matching());
    }
}
